verdict.rationale: Alloy processes customer identity and fraud data and promotes a machine-learning model (Fraud Signal), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a setting, contractual term, or policy that keeps customer data out of model training. The ML marketing claim says nothing about how customer data is used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
